title: Emergence Launch: AI Agents and the future enterprise: Dr. Satya Nitta
talk_summary: This is a short launch talk for Emergence's orchestrator agent and Agent-E web agent, framed around enterprise workflows and self-improving agents. It is mostly positioning and product demo narration, with few concrete mechanisms or measured results.

takeaways.what_they_do: They show a developer dashboard that analyzes prompts to optimize cost and latency and to create/enhance models with customer data.
takeaways.evidence_quote: developer dashboard helps analyze prompts optimize cost and latency create new models with your data

takeaways.what_they_do: They claim the platform is future-proof and can migrate to the latest LLMs on demand, implying a model abstraction layer.
takeaways.evidence_quote: future proof and can migrate to the latest llms on demand

takeaways.what_they_do: They describe an orchestrator agent that plans, acts, verifies, remembers, and improves over time while stitching multiple agents together.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it acts it plans it basically also verifies
